en.headline: Japanese rock band Novelbright opens two-night Hong Kong stand at MacPherson Stadium…
en.dek: The Osaka group’s Asia Tour PYRAMID shows run on 25 and 26 August, with tickets from HK$699 and a VIP package including early entry and a photo opportunity.
body: Japanese rock band Novelbright begins a two-night Hong Kong engagement at MacPherson Stadium in Mong Kok this evening as part of its Asia Tour 2026 PYRAMID.

The one-man shows are scheduled for 7 p.m. on Tuesday 25 August and Wednesday 26 August. Tickets start at HK$699, with a VIP package that includes a standing ticket, early entry and a one-on-one photo opportunity with the band.
The Osaka-based act is known for its blend of rock intensity and melodic storytelling. Tickets are available through Cityline and Live Nation Hong Kong.

zh.headline: 日本搖滾樂隊Novelbright今晚起麥花臣場館兩晚演出
zh.dek: 亞洲巡演「PYRAMID」於8月25及26日晚上7時舉行，門票由699港元起，另設VIP套票包括優先入場及合照機會。
body: 日本搖滾樂隊Novelbright今晚起於旺角麥花臣場館展開兩晚香港演出，屬其亞洲巡演2026「PYRAMID」一部分。
兩場個人演唱會分別於8月25日（星期二）及26日（星期三）晚上7時舉行。門票由699港元起，VIP套票包括企位門票、優先入場及與樂隊一對一合照機會。
這支來自大阪的樂隊以搖滾力度與旋律敘事見稱。門票可於Cityline及Live Nation Hong Kong購得。
